scope: AC1021 POLYLINE_3D absent-string marker; combined with the separately evidenced model-space compound membership fix, this recovers sampled 2D/3D polyline output. No other revision or entity framing changed.
authority: ODA v5.4.1 §20.1 puts the string-present marker as the final pre-handle bit. Producer source (hash below) encodes count ending at bit 120 followed by absent bit, with RL boundary 121. The old generated frame declared RL=120 and LibreDWG reported a -1-bit handle-stream overshoot.
change: For AC1021 POLYLINE_3D with no string data, append a zero absent-string bit before existing byte alignment and handle assembly; the pre-existing POINT/CIRCLE handling remains unchanged.
factorial: Role-only factorial did not prevent 3D fatal. Marker-only scratch removed fatal but left two zero vertices. Independent membership-only scratch also left 3D fatal; membership plus marker recovered all three expected 3D vertices. The source-like exact footer, xdictionary and BYLAYER scratch alternatives were diagnostic only.
combined_oda: Both default MATERIAL and plotstyle opt-ins enabled. AC1021 generated DWGs converted with ODA File Converter 27.1.0 to AC1027 DXF, audit=1. All six modes (LINE, SPLINE, HATCH, 2D/3D POLYLINE and mixed) produced DXF, no .err and empty captured stdout/stderr. 2D output has the three original XY vertices and 3D has (0,0,0),(5,0,1),(5,3,2). The hash-bound LibreDWG/ezdxf peer audit passes all six pairs, including exact 2D/3D vertices and ownership. No broad interoperability or arbitrary profile claim.
validation: Coherent final library relink and ctest --test-dir build-gcc -R '^libdxfrw_dwg_r2007_(polyline3d_footer|primitive_footers)$|^libdxfrw_dwg_polyline_(owned_handle_roles|owner_facade)$|^libdxfrw_dwg_ac1021_polyline_block_membership$' --output-on-failure: 5/5 passed. The footer control checks scalar end and zero footer, old aligned frame parse, truncation/retry, following LINE decoded coordinates, failed entity retry, immutable frame receipt and object CRC.
reproduction: Compile tools/probe_ac1021_curve_geometry.cpp against the coherent library; generate six modes into an empty directory. ODAFileConverter IN OUT ACAD2013 DXF 0 1 '*.dwg'; use tools/audit_ac1021_curve_geometry_peer.py with recorded source/DXF SHA, LibreDWG 0.14 and ezdxf 1.4.5. Manual ODA invocation establishes pairing, not the hashes alone.
limits: Only the enumerated default-normal and geometry profiles are qualified; text, line, hatch and spline cases are included as following/mixed controls.
The matching role-3 ownership fix is separately committed. No fixtures added.
Source producer uses exact unaligned RL boundary 121; this fix keeps the existing writer handle alignment, producing the required absence bit plus zero alignment.
